title: Automated low-cost model-session reuse pilot
question: How do selected cheap model configurations perform in a fresh session with ordinary project artefacts or pre-authored EAL knowledge and persisted observations?

scope.system_or_population: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano on six synthetic orders-service cases.
scope.conditions: Each recipient has native function access enabled or disabled; ordinary and EAL arms share the specification and collector. Initial sessions have native tools.
scope.spatial_scope: Isolated synthetic project directories and OpenAI Responses API.
scope.temporal_scope: One initial and one fresh recipient session per sequence.
exclusions: No human participants or authoring-effort estimate.
No population model-class or isolated reasoning effect.

claims.statement: The selected model configurations produce measurable differences in reference-answer completion and resources when reusing ordinary project artefacts or EAL knowledge.
claims.scope_limit: Recorded behaviour on these six cases, prompts and pinned model versions.
claims.success_consequence: Identify candidate benefits and failure modes for independent follow-up.
claims.failure_consequence: Retain ties, failures, partial results and unavailable evidence without a superiority claim.

assumptions.statement: The reference calculation and scoring labels implement the supplied task specification.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Boundary, missingness and assumption cases checked independently of EAL status.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend affected scores and revise the scorer before interpreting live data.

assumptions.statement: The provider honours the pinned model and configured function/reasoning interface.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Check reported snapshot and retain complete provider responses, usage and attempts.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop on model mismatch, missing access or invalid transport output.

constructs.name: Task completion with reusable knowledge
constructs.definition: Agreement of the final decision and basis with a full-information reference calculation, plus recorded resources.
validity_evidence: Exact-label rubric checked against six explicit specifications.
validity_threats: Recipient without tools may correctly report unavailable evidence while not completing the reference task.
Simple synthetic cases underrepresent engineering work.

measurements.instrument_or_procedure: cases.Case.oracle and runner.Pilot; oracle called after the answer and never used in prompting.
measurements.timing: Every initial and later session; all attempts.
measurements.preprocessing: Exact reference-label match and separately reported evidence_unavailable answers.
measurements.calibration: Known ready/not_ready/undetermined cases; no EAL status in oracle calculation.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic reference scoring; model output may vary across runs.
measurements.validity: Task completion and recorded resource use only; free-text explanation quality and human effort are unmeasured.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same specification and reference in both arms; same donor/recipient configuration within each pair.
measurements.reactivity: A fixed output schema constrains model answers.
measurements.error_model: Retain malformed/incomplete replies, failed calls, unknown costs and unrun sequences.
measurements.blinding: Oracle and collector state are hidden from prompts; the deterministic scorer does not inspect arm labels.

measurements.observable: Calls, usage, setup/initial/later time, tool access and EAL reuse
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds, token/call counts and estimated USD
measurements.timing: Every initial and later session; all attempts.
measurements.preprocessing: Preserve attempts; unknown usage retains a reservation and is separately counted.
measurements.calibration: Scripted provider responses, budget exhaustion, incomplete output and replay tests.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic reference scoring; model output may vary across runs.
measurements.validity: Task completion and recorded resource use only; free-text explanation quality and human effort are unmeasured.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same specification and reference in both arms; same donor/recipient configuration within each pair.
measurements.reactivity: A fixed output schema constrains model answers.
measurements.error_model: Retain malformed/incomplete replies, failed calls, unknown costs and unrun sequences.
measurements.blinding: Oracle and collector state are hidden from prompts; the deterministic scorer does not inspect arm labels.

design.rationale: Compare complete configured workflows on matched tasks and model transitions, with order randomised to reduce order effects.
design.setting: Automated live API calls on synthetic projects.
design.temporal_structure: Two sessions; project artefacts persist and conversation history resets.
design.assignment_method: Enumerate six cases x two recipient models x two tool settings x two arms; shuffle sequence order with the fixed seed.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable: no human allocation; case oracle never enters a prompt.
design.masking: Deterministic scorer reads only decision/basis and the case reference.
design.comparator: Ordinary prompting with specification, collector interface and project notes naturally emitted in the initial session; no supplied runbook or curated previous tool outputs.

units.target_population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano on six synthetic orders-service cases.
units.sampling_frame: Six purposively selected reuse, expiry and assumption cases in cases.py.
units.observational_unit: Session answer, provider request or acquisition event.
units.assignment_unit: Sequence order only; model/tool/arm cells are exhaustively enumerated.
units.analysis_unit: Case-level matched arm comparisons within each recipient configuration; calls are not independent cases.
exclusion_criteria: None after scheduling; failures and unrun rows remain.
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people; two low-cost models selected for documented reasoning interface differences.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Pre-authored EAL source, stable TOML collector binding, initial registration and persisted evidence, runtime assessment before each model session.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Offloaded evidence collection/reuse and scoped assessment.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Existing EALKnowledgeBase and ModelContextAdapter; reinstantiate from persistent storage.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One host assessment per session; recipient function access enabled/disabled separately.
manipulation_checks: Record collected/reused counts and native function calls.
off_target_checks: Same task specification and external collector in both arms.
recovery_checks: No previous model response or function-call history in recipient input.

controls.description: Ordinary prompting with specification, collector interface and project notes naturally emitted in the initial session; no supplied runbook or curated previous tool outputs.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Curated baseline knowledge changing the intended comparator.
controls.implementation: Only model-emitted notes persist alongside original project files.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Inspect retained initial messages and files; exclude unsupported interpretive claims if information was leaked.

controls.description: Independent fixture references and scripted transport checks.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Oracle leakage, status-as-ground-truth, history leakage or budget omission.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Repair failing checks before live execution.

confounds.description: Dedicated reasoning varies with model family; external evidence access differs through the EAL workflow.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Observed differences combine these features with other model/workflow differences.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Match donor and recipient within arm pairs; describe the full configuration.
confounds.diagnostic: Report exact versions, effort setting and native-tool access for every session.
confounds.residual_risk: Cannot isolate reasoning or a single EAL component as the cause.

estimands.population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano on six synthetic orders-service cases.
estimands.comparator: Ordinary prompting with specification, collector interface and project notes naturally emitted in the initial session; no supplied runbook or curated previous tool outputs.
estimands.summary_measure: Reference match counts out of six planned sequences per arm/configuration, paired rows and resource totals.
estimands.interpretation: Exploratory observed performance on the selected tasks; unknown costs and unrun rows remain explicit.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Direct descriptive mapping from retained outputs and usage to counts and totals; no population causal effect is targeted.
identified_parameters: Observed reference matches and known resource totals in executed cells.
rescue_actions: Stop and retain partial records; fix identified defects in a new recorded run.

sampling.method: Fixed purposive six-case coverage pilot, with four recipient configurations and two arms.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: 48 sequences, 96 sessions, at most 288 requests; no optional extension based on scores.
sampling.dependence_structure: Cases recur across cells; prompts and repeated calls are not independent observations.
sampling.multiplicity: All descriptive cell summaries reported; no tests or significance claims.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain failed, stopped and unrun sequences in the planned denominator.
sampling.result: Operational coverage and observed differences, not precise model-class estimates.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Separate decision-only agreement, basis agreement and qualified unavailable-evidence responses.
sampling.stopping_implications: Stop on access/quota/model failure, budget exhaustion or the external job time limit; report partial coverage.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Record plan, seed and code revision before calls; no answer-dependent retries or model substitutions.

models.model_or_procedure: Exact decision/basis agreement with direct task arithmetic and grouped resource counts.

contrasts: EAL versus ordinary within each recipient model/tool setting; inspect matched case rows.
analysis.uncertainty: No confidence intervals or hypothesis tests: small purposive repeated case set. Provider responses and all errors remain available for inspection.
analysis.missing_data: Missing answers fail reference completion; unavailable-evidence qualifications separately reported; missing costs are unknown; unrun cases remain planned.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed plan; three calls per session, 4096 output tokens per call, USD 2 conservative ledger and 45-minute manual workflow job.
robustness_checks: Report exact model/configuration and both session costs.
software_and_versions: Python >=3.11; repository revision in provenance.json; OpenAI Responses API.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Report operational failures and partial cells; a later broader independent study is needed for inferential claims.

decision_matrix.observation_region: All planned sequences executed with valid measurements.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report observed differences without significance or superiority labels.

claim_effects.rationale: Use actual counts and resources to formulate follow-up questions.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Recorded behaviour on these six cases, prompts and pinned model versions.

decision_matrix.next_action: Select broader independent cases targeting observed failure mechanisms.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Access unavailable, budget or time stop, malformed outputs, measurement defects or unexpected results.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Retain partial data and planned denominator; report the specific execution or measurement limitation.

claim_effects.rationale: Incomplete or invalid data do not establish comparative benefit.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Recorded behaviour on these six cases, prompts and pinned model versions.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Repair the identified defect before any fresh run.
decision_matrix.next_action: Restore access or correct the instrument without recasting synthetic checks as live results.

risks.mechanism: Six simple cases and two cheap models underrepresent real work.
risks.prevention: State the bounded target and fixed case set.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: A follow-up needs independently authored broader tasks.
risks.residual_risk: No generalisation to all engineering questions or models.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Fixed prompts, cases, code and plan before live responses.
negative_controls: Missing evidence must not imply measured failure.
positive_controls: Fresh valid observation and expired refreshed observations.
falsification_checks: EAL negative evidence reuse and expired assumption cases.
reporting_controls: Every attempt and unrun allocation retained.
residual_limitations: Unavailable evidence can prevent task completion without a false claim

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic project data and read-only local fixture collectors; no human participants.
mitigations: Do not record headers or credential values; collector inherits no provider environment.
Reserve cost before requests; no hidden retries.
monitoring: Durable request ledger and fixed workflow timeout.
stopping_rules: Access failure, snapshot mismatch, unavailable model, quota or budget limit.
post_stop_actions: Retain attempts and incomplete-run report without spending on replacement models.

feasibility.access: Local OPENAI_API_KEY absent; GitHub connector lacks workflow dispatch. Live account model access unverified.
skills: Existing EAL implementation and provider adapter
resources: Up to 45 minutes of optional manual runner time
dependencies: Credentialed execution and workflow dispatch access
blockers: An authorised execution route must start the credentialed workflow.
feasibility.fallback: Deliver the verified run command and retain blocked-access status; request the necessary browser fallback authorisation.

reproducibility.registration: Dated local protocol and Git revision before calls; exploratory pilot.
immutable_materials: Per-run plan, assignments, provenance and raw request records.
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain synthetic project state, raw responses, costs, errors and derived scores as a workflow artifact; no credentials.
reproducibility.code_plan: Existing Git repository and PR; no automatic workflow trigger.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Pin model snapshots, pricing source/date, code revision, plan digest and timestamps.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: New directory for each run; document defects or changes; do not overwrite attempts.
reproducibility.replication_plan: New independent cases and repeated live runs under separately declared resources.

sources: User request for cheaper model configurations
Official OpenAI model and function-calling documentation
change_log: 1.0.0: automated reuse protocol specified before live calls.

method_selection.rationale: A low-cost, bounded configuration pilot can expose operational differences and failures before a broader developer investigation.
method_selection.inference_framework: Descriptive fixed-case comparison; no population sampling or isolated mechanism inference.
alternatives_considered: Human developer trial measures handover and effort but requires recruitment and independent assessors.
An ablation using a single model with reasoning on/off could isolate configuration effects; selected cheap families differ beyond reasoning.

sources.citation: John W. Tukey (1980), We Need Both Exploratory and Confirmatory, The American Statistician 34, 23-25.
sources.design_consequence: Keep this exploratory pilot separate from an independent confirmatory study.

method_selection.information_criterion: Cover all four recipient configurations and six temporal/evidence cases within USD 2.
permitted_conclusions: Observed reference-task completion and resources for executed cells.
excluded_conclusions: Pure causal effect of reasoning or native tooling
method_selection.discovery_confirmation_separation: Record this pilot as exploratory; independent follow-up cases are required for confirmation.

assignment.procedure: Enumerate six cases x two recipient models x two tool settings x two arms; shuffle sequence order with the fixed seed.
assignment.failure_response: Retain schedule before any calls; unrun sequences remain explicit.

collection.procedure: Bounded provider calls, complete within-session item replay and fresh later input.
collection.failure_response: Stop on fatal access/budget mismatch; retain every attempt.

scoring.procedure: Compare returned labels with Case.oracle after model completion.
scoring.failure_response: Suspend scoring on oracle defects; never use EAL status as reference.

analysis.procedure: Descriptive counts and resources for every arm/configuration.
analysis.failure_response: Report partial coverage and unknown costs.
